annotations.title: Order printed certificates on Zazzle, once voting has closed

description: Order printed certificates on Zazzle, once voting has closed Changes nothing. Contests, quizzes and hunts, after voting closes (409 not_closed before). QRvote writes the certificates as the dashboard's Print page does: one for each award's winner (top3: true for the top three), with their place and how they won, in the contest's language and colors. awards[i] says who certificate i is for. orders[i] maps each size (11x85 is letter, 14x11 is large) to a Zazzle link that opens that certificate filled in; give the person the links, and they order and pay on Zazzle. It's null when the print font can't draw the award or the name (print that one from the dashboard instead). certificates[i] holds the print images. No winners yet means empty lists. Needs the organizer key.

accent.description: The color as 6 hex digits, no #. Leave it out for the contest theme's color, as on the Print page.

slug.description: The id in the public link, e.g. `scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12` from https://qrvote.org/c/scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12

top3.description: The top three of each award, not only the winners
